messages:
kai: Noticed customers can't link usage to the SA when requests are proxied/impersonated. Billing shows caller project only.
mira: Is this only console visibility or does it affect quotas?
kai: Quotas are charged correctly but alerts and dashboards group by origin key which is noisy.
owen: We should emit an `X-RW-Effective-Principal` header from auth-proxy in addition to existing origin header.
mira: Agree. Telemetry pipeline can store `effective_principal` as an optional dimension, but watch cardinailty.
sre-bot: Reminder: new metric dimensions require cardinality review and must not alter billing ETL.
kai: Rollout plan: 1) emit header behind internal flag, 2) collect for 48h, 3) add console column behind feature flag with access gating.
owen: UI note: only show SA links if viewer has access to that project/org; else show "principal hidden".
mira: For storage, cap to top-K principals per org and bucket the rest as `other`. Also record `impersonation_depth`.
kai: I'll open RFC and a small PR for header emission behind a flag. If alerts regress during probe window, revert and page oncall.
sre-bot: RFC created: impersonation-principal-visibility. Include sample cardinality counts.
